component.name: miniti
component.summary: AI meeting assistant with live transcription and coaching

description.p: miniti transcribes every meeting live and surfaces the questions worth asking while they can still be asked. It coaches you to speak with clarity and confidence. Your transcripts and insights stay on your machine, and you own them forever.

ul.li: Live transcript in 11 languages, with remote callers and the people in the room kept apart as separate speakers
Insights while you talk: a rolling summary, the open questions worth asking next, and coaching on fillers, pace and talk ratio
Specialist views: Sales (MEDDPICC) with CRM sync to Attio or Twenty, Playbook answers from your own docs, and fillable templates
Smart meetings: notices when a call may have ended or the next one is about to start, with Google Calendar auto-start and auto-stop
A tray timer, a floating recording surface, desktop notifications, a command line, a control socket and a D-Bus interface for your bar and keybinds
Your data, your tools: local history, Markdown export, webhooks to Zapier, Make or n8n, Granola import

screenshot.caption: A live call: transcript with named speakers on the left, questions worth asking on the right
Coaching overview: a focus for the next meeting, trends, and stats across recent meetings

description.p: A command line, a control socket, a D-Bus interface and a launch-at-login option. The machine stays awake during a meeting, and opening miniti twice no longer opens two copies.
A notice on the home screen when a newer version is available. Installing from source now opens the app instead of an error page.
Templates filled in as the meeting goes, a richer floating recording window, coaching charts with real quotes, a minutes-left counter, text size options and a debug log.
First public release: a recovery key is your account, no email needed, and Settings shows your devices.
